h1: Data Analyst Jobs in India
title: Data Analyst Jobs in India - Fresher & Experienced Openings
description: Data analyst openings at MNCs in India, with skills, eligibility, location and official apply links. Covers SQL, Power BI, Excel and Python based roles.
hero: Data analyst and analytics openings, with the skills each employer asks for.
intro: Data analyst roles usually ask for strong SQL, spreadsheet skills and a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau. Many openings also value Python and a basic understanding of statistics.
If you are preparing, practise SQL queries on real tables, build two or three dashboards you can explain, and read our guide on SQL interview questions for data analyst freshers.

faq.q: What skills do I need for a data analyst job?
faq.a: SQL, Excel, a BI tool such as Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to explain insights in simple language. Python is a common plus.

faq.q: Can a fresher become a data analyst without experience?
faq.a: Yes. Many companies hire freshers and trainees. Projects, SQL practice and a small dashboard portfolio help you show your skills.

faq.q: Are all listings here for freshers?
faq.a: No. Each listing is tagged as Fresher or Experienced, and the job page states the experience required.

h1: Power BI Developer Jobs in India
title: Power BI Developer Jobs in India - Latest Openings
description: Power BI developer and analyst openings at MNCs in India with required skills, eligibility, location and official apply links.
hero: Openings where Power BI is a required or preferred skill.
intro: Power BI roles typically involve cleaning data in Power Query, building a data model, writing DAX measures and designing reports that business teams can use. Employers also look for SQL and clear communication.
To prepare, practise building a star-schema model, writing a few DAX measures such as year-over-year growth, and explaining your dashboards to a non-technical person.

faq.q: Is SQL required for Power BI jobs?
faq.a: Most employers expect it, because the data usually comes from databases. Read each job's requirements to see the exact skills.

faq.q: What should a fresher learn first for Power BI?
faq.a: Start with Power Query for cleaning data, then data modelling, then basic DAX measures, then report design.

h1: SQL Jobs in India
title: SQL Jobs in India - Openings That Ask for SQL Skills
description: Jobs in India that require SQL: data analyst, reporting and software roles at MNCs with eligibility and official apply links.
hero: Openings where SQL is a required or preferred skill.
intro: SQL is one of the most common requirements across data, reporting, testing and software roles. Employers usually test joins, grouping, subqueries and window functions in interviews.
Practise on realistic tables and learn to explain your query step by step. Our SQL interview guide covers the questions that come up most often.

faq.q: Which SQL topics are asked most in interviews?
faq.a: Joins, GROUP BY with HAVING, subqueries, window functions such as RANK and ROW_NUMBER, and handling NULL values.

faq.q: Do I need to know a specific database?
faq.a: The core SQL is similar across databases. The job page lists any specific tools the employer mentions.

h1: Python Developer Jobs in India
title: Python Developer Jobs in India - Fresher & Experienced
description: Python developer and Python-based engineering openings at MNCs in India, with eligibility, location and official apply links.
hero: Openings where Python is a core skill.
intro: Python is used for backend services, automation, data processing and AI work. Fresher roles usually test the basics: data structures, functions, file handling and writing clean, readable code.
Keep one or two small projects on GitHub and be ready to explain how they work. Basic SQL is also valuable because many Python roles work with databases.

faq.q: What do companies test in a Python fresher interview?
faq.a: Core Python, data structures, basic algorithms, simple SQL and your projects.

faq.q: Is a computer science degree compulsory?
faq.a: Each posting states its own criteria. Check the eligibility section on the job page.

h1: Software Engineer & Developer Jobs in India
title: Software Engineer Jobs in India - MNC Developer Openings
description: Software engineer and developer openings at MNCs in India for freshers and experienced candidates, with official apply links.
hero: Software development openings at MNCs and technology firms.
intro: Software engineer and developer roles are the largest group of fresher hiring in technology. Typical selection steps are an online assessment, one or two technical interviews and an HR round.
Revise data structures and algorithms, one programming language in depth, basic SQL and the fundamentals of how the web works. Prepare to explain your projects clearly.

faq.q: How should a fresher prepare for a software engineer interview?
faq.a: Practise data structures and algorithms, learn one language well, revise SQL basics and be ready to discuss your projects.

faq.q: What is the difference between off-campus and on-campus hiring?
faq.a: On-campus hiring happens through your college. Off-campus hiring is open to anyone who meets the criteria and applies directly online.
